owner: current MotorAI Astra review chat; user requested takeover on 2026-10-29
scope: common inner-development diagnostics on existing final checkpoints, not a new training experiment
stages: if no admissible cache exists: separately released zero-update frozen inference
baseline: A0 mechanical; neither C nor G promoted to champion
checkpoint_policy: all 12 existing final88565 checkpoints; no best checkpoint/seed or rerun

quantity.stack_length: selection-bound 0.15 m for all32; recheck source
quantity.torque: CCW-positive N m, truth/prediction from identical stationary-a1 Arkkio operator

mapping: exact native ID join; a2-excluded graph positions are not full-mesh positions; no nearest or nodal averaging
mask: same all-admitted and strict a1 sets per case/step across all arms; no per-arm intersection
metrics: all/a1 area-weighted and unweighted vector and magnitude nRMSE with RMSE T
seen9/unused36 and per-case/PA groups; report all seeds and mean/min/max
casewise torque nRMSE = 100*RMSE(pred-true)/RMS(true), absolute RMSE, mean and ripple
pooled torque nRMSE from all case/step squared errors; do not pool ripple across cases
failures: nonfinite input/intermediate/output is failure, never drop it
missing/duplicate native ID, case or step is failure, never shrink shared mask
zero reference RMS yields undefined normalized metric, retain absolute error; do not add epsilon

proposed_resource_bounds_not_release.historical_timing_reference: C/G evaluation worker sum 510.125 s for six models; new a1 I/O overhead unmeasured
proposed_resource_bounds_not_release.prediction_storage: native a1 fields and sufficient statistics, source/checkpoint/IDs/phase/operator hashes; private storage only

release_requirements: 32/32 geometry admission receipt with all45 proof and exact graph-ID correspondence
full checkpoint hashes verified remotely; historical metadata gaps explicitly resolved
canonical eval integration reviewed, evaluator/operator/mask/environment hashes frozen
existing-score reproduction and synthetic gate pass; no assertion that synthetic tests qualify real data
explicit bounded evaluation release, UTC deadline, disk budget and PID/create-time owner recorded
STOP: owned process only; STOP file, time/resource cap or source/ID/finite mismatch -> stop and preserve partial evidence; retry0
prohibitions: invalid a2 truth or edge restoration
